$comment: What this corpus was read against, and what has been published since.
MPD-2047 (S.O. 4597(E), notified 2026-08-20) is read in part. Its plotted-
housing table (Table 7.2, pp.176-177), the next-lower-category clause (iii),
Other controls (ii), (iv), (v) and (vi) on p.177 (minimum plot, heights, stilt
FAR exemption, stilt required), its setbacks (Table 7.3, p.178), its
plotted-housing parking norms (Table 11.7, p.222) and its basement norms
(13.1.3, p.249) are verified rules from 2026-08-20; each supersedes the
MPD-2021 or UBBL rule for the same plots, so a check dated earlier still uses
those. The owner confirmed that date: the plan states no other commencement
date, and no transition clause has been located.
The rest of MPD-2047 has not been read, including the plotted-housing
controls after (vi) on p.177. Until they are read, a check dated on or after
2026-08-20 says so, rather than implying the corpus is current.

read_against.label: MPD-2047's plotted-housing norms
read_against.note: Table 7.2 and Other controls (ii)-(vi), pp.176-177; Table 7.3 setbacks, p.178; Table 11.7 plotted-housing parking, p.222; 13.1.3 basement, p.249; from 2026-08-20.

unread_successors.source: Stated on page 1 of the gazette: 'approved by the Central Government under Section 11A(2) of DD Act 1957 and notified vide Gazette Notification S.O. No. 4597(E) dated 20.08.2026.'
unread_successors.note: Table 7.2, Other controls (ii)-(vi), Table 7.3 setbacks, Table 11.7 plotted-housing parking and 13.1.3 basement are read and in use from 2026-08-20. Not yet read: the plotted-housing controls after (vi), and other chapters.
